svg.text: 50v50 US-vs-German squad AI · deterministic · sole writers per layer · files in battle/ + battle/modules/
→ all decisions tick here, not per-frame
SQUAD TICK — SquadAI.updateSquad wrappers (per squad, in order)
SOLDIER TICK — SquadAI.updateSoldier → engagement → movement (per soldier)
SUPPORT — data + constraints read by the pipeline
OBSERVE — every tick publishes; nothing here decides
Solid rule: engagement owns combat state · resolver owns destination · progress only observes · commander owns strategy. Retreat/regroup outrank everything; firing stations outrank bounds.

Flows: clocks ↓ squad chain → soldier chain (perceive → FSM → intents → resolver → progress → route → destination) · strategy ↓ objectives/doctrine → leases/routes → squad intents · support → constraints · all → telemetry.
Key files: battle/battle-sim.js · squad-ai.js · engagement.js · movement-resolver.js · commander-ai.js · battle/modules/{16,20,44,47,49,52,53}.js · tools/ai-sim-harness/ for headless checks.
Module versions change; run battle_sim.php and read X-Grasstex-Modules / window.BATTLE_BUILD_DEPLOYED for the live set.
